**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**Forkcast is open source**
- Forkcast's code is now public on GitHub, under the GPL-3.0 license. Anyone can read it, report a problem or suggest a change.
- Updates no longer need a GitHub token. Settings › Updates checks GitHub directly, and the token field is gone. A token saved by an earlier version is deleted from your phone when you open this one; you can also delete it on github.com (Settings › Developer settings › Personal access tokens).
- About now links to the public project page.
